overall_assessment: The alpha distribution validation framework enforces rehearsal contract compliance (release/rehearsal.json verified by check_release_rehearsal.py), CLI and MCP protocol smoke tests with JSON-RPC error boundary handling, and Dockerfile containerization with non-root security principles. Packaging unit tests (test_alpha_release_packaging.py) cover archive normalization, reproducible SHA comparison, exclusion filtering, and error branches with 100% pass rates.

findings.description: mcp_smoke.py provides deterministic synthetic input verification for CLI and MCP distribution artifacts without requiring live network access.
findings.recommendation: Extend smoke suite with protocol version negotiation checks once MCP SDK contracts evolve.

findings.description: Dockerfile uses multi-stage build patterns and non-root execution context, minimizing attack surface in container distributions.
findings.recommendation: Pin base image digest hashes in addition to version tags for container builds.

findings.description: Release rehearsal contract validates expected target matrix, packaging artifacts, and smoke test commands prior to tag creation.
findings.recommendation: Keep rehearsal definitions synchronized with workflow changes.

calibration_notes: Distribution evaluators endorse the offline reproducibility and distribution smoke readiness for alpha milestone completion.
